text: No, not all days were checked for thermal detections on this property due to data availability. The first analysis (run-2) shows that all days from October 1st to October 8th were covered. However, the second analysis (run-1) indicates that only days up to October 7th were covered, with October 8th not being covered due to the latest Near Real-Time (NRT) file update not being published yet. This discrepancy suggests that data for October 8th was not available at the time of the second analysis.
